{{Top}} {{Update|[[Jedi Knights 5]], [[Brotherhood (novel)|Brotherhood]], [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 31]], [[Star Wars Helmet Collection 8]], [[Star Wars Helmet Collection 22]], [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 54]], [[Rise of the Separatists]], [[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]], [[The Crisis on Naboo]], [[The Grand Army of the Republic (reference book)|The Grand Army of the Republic]], [[The Separatists (reference book)|The Separatists]]}} {{Character |type=CIS |image=[[File:NuteGunray-ALTA.png]] |name=Nute Gunray |homeworld=[[Neimoidia]]''[[Star Wars Journeys: The Phantom Menace]]'' |birth= |death=[[19 BBY]], [[Mustafar]]''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' |species=[[Neimoidian]]{{Databank|nute-gunray|Nute Gunray}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=He/him |height=1.91 [[meter]]s {{C|6 [[Foot|ft]], 3 in}}''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' |mass=90 [[kilogram]]s''[[Star Wars Journeys: Beginnings]]'' |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Red]]-gold{{Film|I}} |skin=Green |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Trade Federation]] *[[Galactic Republic]]{{EncyclopediaCite|The Separatists}} **[[Galactic Senate]] *[[Sith]] *[[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]{{Film|II}} **[[Executive Separatist Council]]{{Film|III}} |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|All I know is I never risk my own skin if I don't have to.|Nute Gunray|audio=NeverRiskMyOwnSkin-CoD.flac|{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness}}}} '''Nute Gunray''', a [[Neimoidian]] [[Gender|male]], was a business executive and [[Politics|politician]] who served the [[Trade Federation]] conglomerate, first as its [[senator]] in the [[Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] and later as its [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|Viceroy]], during the final [[Standard decade|decades]] of the [[Republic Era]] up until his [[Death|assassination]]. Alongside his allies, Gunray rose to prominence after the ill-fated [[Eriadu Conference]] left a power vacuum in the [[Directors of the Trade Federation|Federation's leadership]]. Secretly backed by the [[Sith]] [[Sith Lord|Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]], Gunray—who had already secured the title of [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation]]—took control of the conglomerate while [[Lott Dod]] took the seat in the Senate. In [[32 BBY]], Sidious and Gunray manufactured a scenario where the Federation would [[blockade]] the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] with their [[Trade Federation fleet|fleet]] after the passage of [[Prop 31-814D|legislation]] detrimental to the Federation's profits, secretly a ruse for Sidious' alter ego, Naboo's Senator Palpatine, to be elected [[Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic. In the ensuing [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]], Gunray tried coercing [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] into signing a treaty legitimizing his occupation, but she refused, instead escaping the planet with the help of a [[Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight|Knight]] and his [[Padawan]] that Gunray had earlier tried to assassinate, [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Before long, [[Queen]] Amidala returned to Naboo and [[Battle of Naboo|repelled the Federation invasion]], after which Gunray was arrested and taken to [[Coruscant]] to face charges. After four trials in the [[Supreme Court]], Gunray was found not guilty, and he managed to retain his assets and titles. Bitter at the Republic, Gunray allied himself and the company with [[Count]] [[Dooku]], a former [[Jedi Master]], and he pledged Federation military support to the Confederacy of Independent Systems. In return for his investment, Dooku helped Gunray orchestrate a failed [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|attempt]] on Amidala's life, who had since become a Republic senator. As Kenobi investigated the attempted assassination, he discovered the Separatist droid factory on [[Geonosis]], and Gunray watched from afar as the Republic [[Kaminoan]] [[Cloning|clone]] [[army]] arrived and engaged the Confederacy in the [[First Battle of Geonosis]]. After the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars]] in the aftermath of the battle, Gunray became a crucial member of the Confederacy and he attempted to bring the world of [[Rodia]] and its leader, [[Onaconda Farr]], into the Separatist cause while simultaneously ending Amidala's life. Though the plot failed and he was taken into Republic custody, Gunray managed to escape his cell with the help of [[Asajj Ventress]], Dooku's [[Sith assassin]]. After three years of warfare, the Confederacy found itself in disarray following the [[Battle of Coruscant|deaths]] of Dooku [[Battle of Utapau|and]] [[cyborg]] [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies|Supreme Commander of the Droid Army]], [[General]] [[Grievous]]. The surviving Separatist Council members, led by Gunray, sought protection on Mustafar, but they were eventually killed by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] at the order of his new master. Gunray was the last to be killed by [[Skywalker lightsaber|Vader's blue blade]], pleading for his life, which ultimately brought a final end to the Clone Wars. The [[Galactic Empire]] then nationalized the Trade Federation and official Imperial records stated that Gunray had taken his own life after he realized there was no chance of a Separatist victory. ==Biography== ===Rise to power=== A [[Homeworld|native]] of the [[planet]] [[Neimoidia]], Nute Gunray lived during the latter [[Standard decade|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic]].''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' the ruthless [[Neimoidian]] [[Gender|male]] had risen to the powerful position of [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation]] by [[34 BBY]].The events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knights]]'' take place during the time [[Finis Valorum]] is [[Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] according to [[Jedi Knights 1|''Jedi Knights'' 1]], but also at least two [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Naboo]] according to ''Jedi Knights'' 5, as the issue is set "years" before the Battle of [[Naboo]]. As ''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]'' establishes that the Supreme Chancellor served four-[[Standard year|year]] terms, and the flashback section of [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] which mentions of Valorum's re-election is dated to [[36 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'', Valorum must have served as Chancellor beginning in [[40 BBY]]. ''Timelines'' also dates the Battle of Naboo to [[32 BBY]], therefore meaning ''Jedi Knights''—including the events of ''Jedi Knights'' 5, which features Gunray and sees him mentioned as [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation]]—must take place between 40 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and 34 BBY. After the disaster that was the [[Eriadu Conference]]''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' in [[33 BBY]],{{InsiderCite|200|A Certain Point of View}} states that the [[Eriadu]] trade summit took place 33 [[Standard year|years]] prior to the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'' Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], corresponds to [[33 BBY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. Gunray was able to rise to total leadership over the [[Trade Federation]] under his [[Viceroy]] title. In secret, Gunray owed his rise to power to the engineering and manipulation of [[Darth Sidious]], a [[Dark Lord of the Sith]]''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' with whom he would ally. At some stage of his tenure as Viceroy, Gunray authored a Federation advertisement known as ''[[Safe In Our Hands]]''. It was created by the Federation's public relations agency, [[Eleven Star Marketing]], and the advertisement featured a Neimoidian hand holding [[Coruscant]] in its palm, and some feared that it represented Gunray's ambitions to own Coruscant itself and extend his growing influence. Under Gunray's direction, these claims were dismissed as anti-Neimoidian prejudice.''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]'' ===The Naboo Crisis=== ====Dispute in the Senate==== {{Quote|You will sign it, or you will suffer.|Nute Gunray orders Queen Amidala to sign the treaty|''[[Queen's Peril]]''}} Following the failure of a taxation bill in the Galactic Senate, Viceroy Gunray conferred with Darth Sidious, furious that Naboo Senator Palpatine's introduction of a bypass amendment had cost the Trade Federation the allegiance of the [[Delcontrian faction|Delcontrian]] faction. Sidious assured Gunray that a new bill would be presented to the Senate in a matter of days which would win the Delcontrian faction back, though a doubtful Gunray responded by muttering something beneath his breath which Sidious could not hear. At the same time, under Sidious's direction, Gunray had sunk considerable money into the creation of a [[battle droid]] fighting force, which was undertaking training maneuvers on [[Geonosis]]. When the time was right, Sidious instructed Gunray to cease these training exercises and put his new army to the test. Nute Gunray contacted Queen Amidala of Naboo and introduced himself, forcefully instructing her to sign a treaty with the Trade Federation which would, essentially, give them control of the entire planet. Amidala refused to sign the treaty, and Gunray implemented the next phase of Lord Sidious's plan; blockading Naboo with a fleet of Battleships. ====Blockade==== {{Quote|What? What did you say?''"
"''The ambassadors are Jedi Knights, I believe.|Nute Gunray and TC-14||audio=Gunray-TC-14-JediKnights.flac}} [[File:Sith_Lords_Trade_Federation.png|thumb|250px|Viceroy Gunray and Rune Haako conferring with Darth Sidious and Darth Maul.]] The Naboo Crisis arose as a result of a dispute between the Trade Federation and the [[Galactic Republic]] relating to the [[Prop 31-814D|taxation of trade routes]] to outlying [[Star system|systems]]. At the instigation of Darth Sidious—secretly [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] [[Senator]] Palpatine—the Trade Federation decided to force a resolution to the dispute by [[Blockade|blockading]] the planet [[Naboo]] with a [[fleet]] of [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter|modified battleships]], cutting off all shipping to the planet. Gunray commanded the blockade itself from his [[flagship]] ''[[Saak'ak]]'', a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|Droid Control Ship]]. In response to the Naboo Crisis, [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]] dispatched two [[Jedi]], the [[Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to negotiate a peaceful resolution to the dispute. Viceroy Gunray allowed the Jedi [[Emissary|emissaries]] to land their ship ''[[Radiant VII]]'' in the ''Saak'ak''{{'s}} [[hangar]] bay. After learning that the emissaries were Jedi, Gunray and the ship's [[captain]] [[Daultay Dofine]] panicked and contacted [[Darth]] Sidious via [[hologram]]. Lord Sidious ordered Gunray to [[Death|kill]] the two Jedi and to invade the planet Naboo. Gunray questioned the legality of such an action, but Sidious quickly silence his concerns by telling the Viceroy that he would "make it legal" in the [[Galactic Senate]]. Under Gunray's orders, the emissary's ship ''Radiant VII'' was destroyed and [[poison gas]] was released into the reception room hosting the two Jedi. Gunray also dispatched a group of [[OOM-series security droid|security battle droids]] to [[Escape from the Saak'ak|finish off]] the Jedi. However, the two Jedi managed to survive the attempted [[poison]]ing and quickly dispatched the [[battle droid]]s before advancing on the bridge. Gunray quickly responded by sealing the blast doors of the bridge and calling for [[droideka]]s, which managed to overwhelm the Jedi before they could cut through the doors. Shortly later, Gunray was contacted by the Naboo [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], who, once again, refused to sign a treaty with the Trade Federation. Gunray was smug in his dealings with Amidala, confidently assuring her that he knew nothing of the supposed ambassadors. Despite the threat posed by the Jedi, Gunray still proceeded with the invasion, beginning with severing all communication to the planet. [[C-9979 landing craft]] were used to land the Trade Federation's [[Trade Federation Droid Army|droid army]] on Naboo, and [[OOM command battle droid]] [[OOM-9]] was ordered to look out for the Jedi. The [[army]] then proceeded to [[Capture of Theed|capture]] the [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Theed]] and other major centers. The Trade Federation's [[droid]] army succeeded in occupying Naboo with little resistance and managed to capture Queen Amidala and her entourage. Following the occupation of Theed, Gunray visited the captured Queen himself and reiterated his demand that she sign a treaty with the Federation. She refused, and so she and the others were to be taken to [[Camp Four]]. ====Battle of Naboo==== [[File:EmperorGunray.png|left|thumb|275px|Nute Gunray seated at Queen Amidala's throne during the occupation of Naboo.]] Gunray suffered a setback when the two Jedi and a local [[Gungan]] guide named [[Jar Jar Binks]] managed to free the Queen and her entourage, and escape offworld. Meanwhile, Viceroy Gunray and [[Settlement Officer]] [[Rune Haako]] presided over the occupation of Naboo from the [[Theed Royal Palace]]. Naboo's population was forced into camps where they experienced starvation and hardship. In Amidala's absence, Gunray assumed her throne{{SWE|characters|nutegunray|Nute Gunray}} and held [[Governor]] [[Sio Bibble]] prisoner. Gunray taunted the Governor from atop his [[Mechno-chair]], but the Governor resisted Gunray's attempts to break him. In an attempt to force Queen Amidala to resurface, Gunray personally visited one of the internment camps with a captive Bibble in tow. Gunray had Bibble brought before one of the Queen's handmaidens, [[Saché]], telling the Governor that the Naboo had failed to protect their own citizens. Saché pleaded with the Governor to contact the Queen and tell her that the death toll on Naboo was "catastrophic." Gunray departed, satisfied, and Bibble was forced to transmit a message to the Queen. Unknown to him, that word, having been found to be less used than similar terms, was one pre-selected by Amidala and her handmaidens as a message. In the Senate on Coruscant, the Trade Federation's Senator [[Lott Dod]] managed to block Queen Amidala and Senator Palpatine's efforts to request Republic intervention in Naboo. However, Queen Amidala, at the instigation of Palpatine, managed to outmaneuver the Trade Federation by calling for a [[Vote of No Confidence]] against Chancellor Valorum. As the occupation deepened, the droid army began to move against the Gungans, Naboo's amphibious indigenous civilization, who lived in [[Water|underwater]] cities like [[Otoh Gunga]]. Facing little resistance, the Trade Federation removed most of their fleet from Naboo with the exception of the Droid Control Ship ''[[Vuutun Palaa]]''. The diminished Trade Federation naval presence enabled Queen Amidala, her entourage, her Jedi allies, and Binks to land their [[Naboo Royal Starship|starship]] on Naboo. Queen Amidala managed to rally the [[Naboo resistance]] and forge an alliance with the Gungan leader [[Boss]] [[Rugor Nass]]. Seeking to drive out the Trade Federation, Amidala devised a three-pronged battle plan which involved the [[Gungan Grand Army]] marching on Theed to draw away the droid army. Meanwhile, Naboo forces under Amidala and her Jedi allies would infiltrate Theed and capture the Viceroy. Naboo forces would also capture the hangar bay at the royal palace and use their [[N-1 starfighter]]s to destroy the Droid Control Ship, incapacitating the droid army. In response to this renewed threat from Amidala and the Jedi, Darth Sidious dispatched his [[Sith apprentice]], [[Maul|Darth Maul]], to reinforce the Viceroy. Gunray soon detected that the Queen's royal starship had been cleared the blockade and landed on the planet, and dispatched Battle Droids to salvage the craft. Gunray contacted Darth Maul on his approach to Naboo and asked if he wished to search for the Queen and her party, but Maul suggested to Gunray that he "let them come us." After receiving reports that the Gungan Grand Army was marshalling outside Theed, Gunray dismissed them as primitives and asked for Lord Sidious' permission to wipe them out. At Sidious's urging, Gunray sent the majority of his droid army to wipe out the Gungan forces. During the [[Battle of Naboo]], Gunray believed himself to be away from the fighting the within the Theed Royal Palace. With the bulk of the droid army preoccupied with the Gungans, Queen Amidala and her Jedi allies were able to infiltrate the Palace and secure the N-1 starfighters, which proceeded to launch a [[starfighter]] strike on the ''Vuutun Palaa''. While Master Qui-Gon and Padawan Kenobi took on Darth Maul in a [[lightsaber duel]], Queen Amidala's forces fought their way through the Royal Palace. [[File:Gunray_captured.png|thumb|right|275px|Nute Gunray and Rune Haako captured by Queen Amidala and her troops.]]Gunray's droidekas managed to capture Queen Amidala and some her party and brought them into the [[Throne room (Theed Royal Palace)|throne room]], where a triumphant Gunray reiterated his demand that she sign a treaty with the Trade Federation. However, the Queen's disguised handmaiden arrived in the throne room with reinforcements, confusing Gunray and his battle droids. Gunray ordered his droids to pursue the decoy Queen, dividing his forces, and the real Queen used the opportunity disable Gunray's remaining droids and take the Viceroy and Haako captive. Meanwhile in [[Realspace|space]], [[Anakin Skywalker]] destroyed the Droid Control Ship with a missile fired from his starfighter. This effectively disabled the entire Federation droid army; turning the tide of the battle decisively in favor of the Naboo and their Gungan allies. Elsewhere, Kenobi managed to seemingly kill Darth Maul but lost Master Qui-Gon, who succumbed to injuries inflicted by Darth Maul. With the defeat of the Federation's droid army, Viceroy Gunray and Haako were held prisoner by the Naboo and then [[transport]]ed to Coruscant to face trial for their crimes on Naboo. ===Supreme Court trials=== {{Quote|It's outrageous, that after four trials in the Supreme Court, Nute Gunray is ''still'' the Viceroy of the Trade Federation.|[[Sio Bibble]]|}} Gunray spent the next four years undergoing trials in the Supreme Court.''[[Queen's Shadow]]'' Kenobi was involved in the trials against Gunray but found them to be toothless.[[Brotherhood (novel)|''Brotherhood'']] Gunray's lawyers worked feverishly to ensure that nothing ever came of these trials, and though they cost the Viceroy a fortune in legal fees, no charges were ever brought against him. Gunray's third trial ended in a hung jury, and his fourth found him not guilty, allowing him to retain his assets and titles. Bitter over his defeat at Naboo, Gunray developed a deep seated grudge against the one person he blamed for his subsequent legal troubles; Padmé Amidala, now a senator for Naboo in the [[The galaxy|Galactic]] Senate. At Gunray's direction, the Trade Federation covertly used [[TriNebulon News]] to spread rumours about Amidala, attempting to discredit her early Senate career by running negative stories on her youth and inexperience. After the conclusion of Gunray's fourth trial, rumors circulated that he had gone as far as to put a price on Amidala's head. ===Separatist Crisis=== ====Seeking revenge==== {{Quote|What about the Senator from Naboo? Is she dead yet? I'm not signing your treaty until I have her head on my desk.''"
"''I am a man of my word, Viceroy.|Nute Gunray and Dooku|}} [[File:JourneysBeginnings-SepCouncil.png|thumb|left|300px|Gunray with Dooku and other members of the Separatist Council on Geonosis.]] After his many trials, Gunray grew more bitter at the Republic, and he eventually joined the growing [[Separatist Crisis|secessionist movement]] under the leadership of [[Count]] [[Dooku]] of [[Serenno]]—a former Jedi Master who had become Darth Tyranus and Sidious' new apprentice. The Secessionist Movement was a confederation of a thousand star systems and corporations that were dissatisfied with the rampant taxation and excessive corruption within the Republic. In [[24 BBY]]''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' dates the [[Raxus Address|beginning]] of the Separatist Crisis to two [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Clone Wars]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates as beginning in [[22 BBY]]. Therefore, the Separatist Crisis must have begun in [[24 BBY]]. Dooku delivered the [[Raxus Address]], in which he denounced the Republic as a futile enterprise rife with favoritism and corruption that harmed the outer systems in order to benefit the Core Worlds.''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' In the wake of the speech, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] was formed. Gunray agreed to pledge his support for the Separatists in return for one thing: that his old adversary, Senator Amidala, be killed so that he could finally get revenge for his loss during the Naboo Crisis. Dooku agreed to the Viceroy's demands and he arranged for the [[bounty hunter]]s [[Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell]] to [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|assassinate the senator]]. The [[bounty]] hunters launched two unsuccessful attempts, which only drew the [[Jedi Order]]'s attention to the existence of a [[Grand Army of the Republic|clone army]] being created for the Republic on the planet [[Kamino]]. While pursuing Fett, Kenobi discovered that a droid army was being constructed for the Separatists on the [[desert]] planet of [[Geonosis]]. As he spied on their dealings, he saw Dooku, Gunray, Haako, [[Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser]], and [[Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor]] walking to a secret meeting, with Dooku discussing how they needed to convince the [[Commerce Guild]] and [[Corporate Alliance]] to sign their treaty. Gunray asked about Amidala, remarking that he refused to sign the treaty until her head was on his desk, but Dooku assured the Viceroy that he was a man of his word. ====A meeting turned battle==== [[File:Dooku_Gunray_arena.png|thumb|right|250px|Viceroy Gunray, Count Dooku, and Haako at the Petranaki arena watching Amidala, Kenobi, and Anakin Skywalker.]] Upon arriving at their meeting, all corporate leaders [[Geonosian accord|pledged their support]] for the Separatist Movement. With their new droid army, the Separatists hoped they could mount a successful challenge against the Republic and their Jedi defenders. Shortly later, Kenobi along with Senator Amidala and Padawan Skywalker were captured by [[Geonosian]]s following a skirmish in the Geonosian droid factory. After Amidala and her companions were [[Death penalty|sentenced to death]] and forced to fight in the [[Petranaki Arena]] against the arena creatures—a [[reek]], and an [[acklay]]—and the Geonosian [[picador]]s, Gunray attended the proceedings, accompanied by Haako, Dooku, Poggle, Jango Fett, and his "son" [[Boba Fett]]. When Amidala was savagely attacked by the [[nexu]] in the arena, the Viceroy chucked in glee. However, Gunray's hopes for revenge against the Senator were dashed when she and her Jedi allies managed to evade the creatures. In their ensuing escape, Gunray ordered Jango to kill her, but Dooku asked that Gunray have patience, as Amidala would die nonetheless. Gunray and the Separatist allies suffered another blow, however, when a Jedi strike force lead by Jedi Master [[Mace Windu]] attacked the Petranaki arena. As a battle broke out, Haako and Gunray remained close to Dooku, and when blaster fire raced by them, the Neimoidians ducked and covered. Shortly thereafter, [[clone trooper]] forces under [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] attacked the arena, forcing Gunray, Haako, and Dooku to retreat into the [[Geonosian War Room]]. Inside, the Viceroy commented on how the Jedi has amassed a massive army, and Dooku pondered to himself how they could have come up with it so quickly. Gunray suggested that they send all available droids into battle, but the Separatist Droid Army proved inferior to the Republic's [[Cloning|clone]] [[trooper]]s. With the battle turning in favor of the Grand Army of the Republic and their Jedi [[commander]]s, Gunray commented that the situation was not looking good, and Haako suggested that they get the Trade Federation Core Ships into space. Gunray did as Haako suggested, and he retreated from Geonosis to supervise the evacuation of the Trade Federation Core Ships. This battle marked the spark of the [[Clone Wars]], a [[Galaxy|galactic]]-wide conflict between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. ===The Clone Wars=== ====The opening days==== By joining the Separatists, Gunray was left unreachable by Republic law, again allowing him to avoid justice for his previous crimes,''[[Queen's Hope]]'' while the Federation itself remained neutral to do business with both sides. The official story was that Gunray led a splinter faction that was fully devoted to the Confederacy. During the first days of the war after Geonosis, Gunray arrived, in person, on the planet [[Nooroyo]] to negotiate trade of its [[spice]] export, unaware that Amidala and Skywalker had [[Mission to Nooroyo|arrived]] as well to rescue members of the Naboo [[Torada Collective]] who were staying on planet. Upon being informed that Gunray was on planet and that he would certainly send someone to their [[Padmé Amidala's H-type Nubian yacht|H-type Nubian yacht]] because it was a Naboo ship, Amidala and Skywalker were forced to speed up their mission and leave quickly. As [[Queen]] [[Jamillia]]'s sister [[Antraya]] was the only member of the collective willing to leave, they left only with her as a [[droid starfighter]] started to close in. Several weeks into the war, rumors reached Gunray and his allies that a splinter group was emerging in the Federation that sought to wrestle control of the corporation. As such, Gunray and his allies asked Dooku to take action. Led by [[Oje N'deeb]], the faction indeed existed and made contact with Amidala during the [[siege on Hebekrr Minor]], hoping to take Dod's Senate seat and redeem the image of the Federation to the Republic. Upon learning of the splinter group, Sidious ordered Dooku to hold Gunray and the others back from snuffing out the splinter cell, as the Sith Lord hoped to use them for his own plans. ====Capture on Rodia==== {{Quote|The Separatist leader Nute Gunray has promised to support us with a very generous relief effort. Neh-soo-bo-wah. He is giving us food, ships, and protection.''"
"''Nute Gunray cannot be trusted. He will bring war to your system just as he did to mine many years ago.''"
"''I am afraid I have already done what I must for my people.|Onaconda Farr and Padmé Amidala|{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}}}} [[File:Nute777.png|thumb|left|250px|Nute Gunray on Rodia with his battle droids.]] At some point following the Battle of Geonosis, Nute Gunray turned his attention to the Outer Rim world of [[Rodia]]. The planet had been attacked by [[pirate]]s and Rodia's Republic Senator [[Onaconda Farr]] had appealed to Viceroy Gunray for help. The Viceroy agreed to send relief supplies to Rodia in return for one small favor: kidnapping his long-time foe Senator Amidala. Farr was a close friend of the Naboo Senator and called her to Rodia under the pretext of seeking aid from the Republic for the [[Rodian]] people. Senator Amidala was escorted by her long-time friend [[Junior Representative|Representative]] Jar Jar Binks and her [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]]. Upon arriving, Senator Amidala and C-3PO were captured. After learning of her capture, Gunray ordered that she be manacled as a precaution before he traveled to Rodia to meet her. However, Gunray's plans encountered an unexpected obstacle in the form of Binks, who managed to elude the Viceroy's battle droids and trick them into believing that he was a Jedi. In the midst of the commotion, Amidala and C-3PO managed to escape and contact the Republic for assistance before they were recaptured by Gunray's battle droids. After arriving on Rodia, Gunray applied pressure on Farr by withholding relief supplies until Senator Amidala was executed. When Senator Farr protested, Gunray responded that the planet was now under his protection. After Gunray's droid forces had recaptured Senator Amidala and C-3PO, he assembled a trio of droidekas to execute them. Before Gunray could carry out the sentence, Binks and a [[Kwazel Maw]] monster that he had befriended named "[[Bogey (Kwazel Maw)|Bogey]]" burst out from the swamp and overwhelmed the droidekas. The Viceroy attempted to flee aboard his [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]] but "Bogey" knocked it into the swamp. He was then held by Senator Amidala at [[Blaster|gunpoint]]. Shortly later, Farr arrived and revealed that he and Amidala had planned to trap Gunray all along. Shortly later, Republic forces of the [[41st Elite Corps]] arrived and took Gunray into custody. ====Escape from Republic custody==== {{Quote|I am a man of great wealth, and I can be very ''generous'' to my allies.''"
"''That is a ''very'' tempting offer, Viceroy. In the meantime, I have a gift for ''you''.|Viceroy Nute Gunray is presented with handcuffs from Gree|audio=GunrayGreeGift.flac|}} [[File:GunrayBribery-CoD.png|thumb|right|250px|A captive Gunray attempts to bribe Commander Gree.]] Following the events on Rodia, the captive Gunray was transferred aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tranquility]]'' for trial on Coruscant. Due to his high status in the Confederacy, the [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]] dispatched Jedi Master [[Luminara Unduli]] and Master Skywalker's Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano]] to guard Gunray. The two Jedi were reinforced by a group of [[Senate Guard]]s led by Captain [[Faro Argyus]] and a squad of clone troopers led by [[Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)|Gree]]. In response to Gunray's capture, Sidious and Dooku dispatched the [[Dathomirian]] [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] [[assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress]] to infiltrate the ''Tranquility'' and rescue or kill the Trade Federation Viceroy to prevent him from giving up their secrets. While in captivity, Gunray was interrogated by Unduli and Tano but refused to cooperate. When a frustrated Tano threatened the Viceroy, Unduli chastised the younger Jedi. Their interrogation was interrupted by the arrival of Separatist attack force consisting of Separatist [[Vulture-class starfighter|Vulture droids]] and three [[Droch-class boarding ship|''Droch''-class boarding ships]]. While Separatist droids boarded the ''Tranquility'', Ventress took advantage of the chaos to sabotage the ship's [[power generator]]s. After Unduli departed with several Clone troopers to fight the intruders, Ventress managed to overpower Ahsoka and free Gunray. Before Gunray could escape with the dark side warrior, Master Luminara returned to the cell and fought with Ventress in the ship's elevator shaft and generator room. [[File:ArgyusGunrayEscape-CoD.png|thumb|left|220x220px|Gunray and Argyus escape aboard their stolen Republic frigate]] While Luminara was dueling with Ventress, Gunray was locked in his [[Prison|cell]] with Tano and Argyus standing guard. Unknown to the Republic and Jedi, Argyus was a [[Treason|traitor]] who was secretly working for Dooku. When Ahsoka departed the brig to help Luminara, Argyus took the opportunity to overpower his fellow [[Senate Commando]]s and freed Gunray. Gree managed to overpower Argyus, but Gunray, unnoticed by the clone Commander, picked up a fallen blaster and knocked him unconscious. The Viceroy and his rescuer then escaped on a Republic [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)|''Consular''-class cruiser]] in the lower hangar and were joined by Ventress, who had escaped her Jedi foes in a [[Republic escape pod]]. Gunray was present when Ventress killed Argyus by impaling him through the chest with [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers|lightsaber]], and after the death Gunray told Ventress he had "always had a good feeling about" her, which was what he had told Argyus as well. ====Assisting Count Dooku==== {{Quote|You have nothing, Jedi fools! I welcome you to your doom! Hahahahaha!|Nute Gunray mocks his Jedi pursuers|{{TCW|Lair of Grievous}}}} Following his escape, Gunray assisted Dooku in luring Jedi Master [[Kit Fisto]], his former apprentice Jedi Knight [[Nahdar Vebb]], and several clone troopers into a trap at [[General]] [[Grievous]]'s [[Grievous's fortress|fortress]] on [[Vassek]]. Count Dooku wanted General Grievous to prove his worth of leading the Droid Army by killing the intruders since he recently had been [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula|experiencing]] [[Raid on Skytop Station|defeats]] at the hands of the Jedi thus shaking Sidious's trust in him. As part of the plot, a hologram of Gunray was used to taunt his Jedi and Republic pursuers. Gunray took great pleasure in deceiving the Jedi and laughed as he welcomed them to their doom. Shortly later, the Jedi and clone troopers were [[Mission to Grievous's castle|attacked]] by Grievous. Vebb and all the Republic clones present on the mission, with the exception of Fisto, were killed. ====Working with Cad Bane==== {{Quote|When Darth Sidious asked me to loan you the Federation fleet, he didn't say you were going to war! Bane, you've already lost four of my ships! I hope you can pay for all of this!"''
''"One authentic Jedi holocron and the memory crystal I was after. When my benefactor gets this, he will compensate you for your puny fleet.|Gunray and [[Cad Bane]]|{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}}} Under Darth Sidious' orders, Gunray dispatched several ships of the [[Trade Federation fleet|Federation fleet]] including [[Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] to assist the bounty hunter [[Cad Bane]] on the planet [[Devaron]]. Bane had stolen a Jedi [[Kyber memory crystal]], which contained information of value to Sidious, and kidnapped the Jedi Master [[Bolla Ropal]]. Despite Bane's successes, Gunray was furious to learn that Bane had lost four ships to Republic forces during the [[Battle of Devaron]]. When the Neimoidian demanded payment, Bane promised that Lord Sidious would compensate the Viceroy for his lost forces once the holocron had been opened. After Bane killed Ropal for refusing to open the crystal, the bounty hunter managed to kidnap Ahsoka during a skirmish aboard [[Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate|his ''Munificent'' frigate]]. Taking Ahsoka hostage, Bane was able to force Anakin to open the memory crystal. After extracting the desired information from the memory crystal, Bane escaped and reported his success to Gunray, who offered to send him a rescue ship if he disclosed the data from the crystal. However, Bane refused and insisted on sending the information directly to Darth Sidious. Bane escaped into space as the last ship in Gunray's fleet was destroyed. ===Death of the Republic=== ====Summit on Utapau==== {{Quote|It won't be long before the armies of the Republic track us here. I'm sending you to the Mustafar system, in the Outer Rim. It is a volcanic planet. You will be safe there.''"
"''Safe? Chancellor Palpatine managed to escape your grip, General. Without Count Dooku, I have doubts about your ability to keep us safe.''"
"''Be thankful, Viceroy, you have not found yourself in my grip...Your ship is waiting.|Grievous and Gunray exchange words over Grievous's ability to protect them properly|}} [[File:Sep_council.png|thumb|right|250px|Gunray along with the Separatist Council on Utapau.]] Following the death of Count Dooku at the hand of Skywalker and the defeat of the Separatist fleet during the [[Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY]], Gunray and the other members of the Separatist Council met with General Grievous on the planet [[Utapau]], which had become their hideout. With the Republic closing in on the Separatist leadership, Grievous informed the Council that he was transferring them to the volcanic planet of [[Mustafar]] for their safety, though this order was truly Sidious'. Gunray, however, responded by angrily rising from his seat and questioning the cyborg General's abilities to keep the council safe; citing Grievous' failure to capture Chancellor Palpatine on Coruscant and the death of Count Dooku. Angered by Gunray's complaints, Grievous remarked that the Viceroy should be thankful not to find ''himself'' in his grip before dismissing the Council, telling them that their ship was waiting. The Separatist leaders followed Grievous' instructions and departed Utapau for Mustafar moments before the arrival of Kenobi and the [[212th Attack Battalion]], who [[Battle of Utapau|engaged]] the cyborg General and the Separatist garrison stationed on Utapau. It was during the battle that Kenobi finally killed Grievous, dealing a crippling blow to the Confederate war effort and effectively ending the War. ====Time on Mustafar and death==== {{Quote|The war is over! Lord Sidious promised us peace! We only want—[screams]|Nute Gunray's last words, to Darth Vader|audio=NuteGunraysLastWords.flac|}} [[File:TheDeathofNuteGunray.png|thumb|250px|Gunray is slaughtered by the newly christened Darth Vader along with the rest of the Separatist Council on Mustafar.|left]] With his personal riches nearly wiped out, the nationalization of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]], and the loss of his assets on Cato Neimoidia, Gunray was left with just the Council in the conflict's final phases. With Grievous' defeat on Utapau, Gunray and the other leading members of the council continued to monitor and command what was left of the Separatist forces from the [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility|complex]] on Mustafar. However, Gunray and the rest of the council, already demoralized by the deaths of Count Dooku and General Grievous, only wanted to sue for peace. Gunray believed that, with Dooku and Grievous dead, he would gain more power{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|33|History of the Ship}} and eventually some benefit from the war. After seducing Skywalker to the dark side and [[Order 66|initiating]] the [[Great Jedi Purge]], Sidious betrayed the Viceroy and the defeated Confederacy, by [[Mission to Mustafar|dispatching]] his new apprentice, now called Darth Vader, to Mustafar to kill Gunray and the other Separatist leaders. Sidious also informed the Separatist leaders of Darth Vader's arrival, but claimed that he had come to make peace with them. After Lord Vader landed, Gunray greeted the Sith apprentice, who then proceeded to shut the blast doors and execute the Separatist Council with his lightsaber. The Trade Federation Viceroy was the very last to be slain. As Vader cornered Gunray, he attempted to reason with Vader, telling the newly appointed Sith Lord that the War was over and Lord Sidious had promised them peace. However, Lord Vader ignored Gunray's pleas and proceeded to slash him across the chest with his lightsaber, killing him. Rather than recognizing the consequences of joining an alliance with a monster as vile and devious as a Sith Lord, Gunray was blinded by his desire for wealth and power. ===Legacy=== Once Gunray and all the Separatist leaders had been disposed of, Vader was instructed by Sidious to transmit the order to deactivate all remaining droid units of the Separatist Droid Army, which, coupled with Sidious' [[Proclamation of the New Order|proclamation]] of his [[New Order]] and the reorganization of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]], officially ended the Clone Wars. [[File:NuteGunraysCorpse-2020DarthVader7.png|thumb|right|300px|Once a man who wielded great power, Nute Gunray's body was left abandoned in the ruins of the Separatist headquarters.]] Vader's slaughter of the Separatist leaders was covered up by the Empire, and official Imperial records stated that Gunray had taken his own life after he realized there was no chance of a Separatist victory. Following Gunray's death, the Trade Federation and its assets were dissolved by the Empire.[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']] Sometime after the [[Duel on Cloud City]], Sidious brutally punished Vader and left him stranded on Mustafar in an attempt to strengthen his connection to the dark side of [[the Force]]. During his punishment, Vader found Gunray's decomposing corpse still in the remains of the former Separatist stronghold after he made his way into the complex. The discovery triggered Vader to have a flashback to his slaughter of Gunray and the rest of the Separatist Council.[[Darth Vader (2020) 7|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 7]] ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Don't shoot! I am an innocent pawn!|Nute Gunray, showing his cowardice|}} [[File:Gunray_command.png|thumb|left|200px|Nute Gunray played a major role in the Invasion of Naboo.]] As Viceroy of the Trade Federation, Nute Gunray was powerful, deceitful and willing to kill for his financial benefit.{{ForceCollection|Nute Gunray|star=3}} While, on the surface, he did not appear to be an economic genius,{{GermanFanCite|84|Database}} he was indeed a cutthroat and threatening business leader{{SWE|characters|nutegunray|Nute Gunray}} who was primarily concerned with maximizing profits and his own well-being. His opposition to the Galactic Republic Senate's taxation of trade routes led him to impose a military blockade of the planet Naboo. Gunray wanted to force the-then Naboo Queen Padmé Amidala to sign a favorable treaty with the Trade Federation. His desire to achieve these goals led him to blockade and subsequently occupy Naboo, which generated much hostility towards both Gunray and the Federation. While the wider galactic public thought that the Viceroy's Invasion of Naboo was solely motivated by greed, few were aware that Gunray was being manipulated from behind the scenes by the Sith Lord Darth Sidious. Gunray was openly fearful of his Sith benefactor, and though working with Sidious often yielded great rewards, the Viceroy often showed frustration with Sidious' apparent lack of concern for the Trade Federation's profits. Captain [[Mariek Panaka]] once remarked that it seemed like no one but Gunray himself could understand what he wanted, but Jedi Master [[Mace Windu]] believed Gunray would at least be opposed to killing civilian Neimoidians to reach his goals. Due to Amidala's role in his defeat on Naboo, Gunray harbored a deep grudge towards the Naboo politician and made several attempts on her life in the years following the Invasion of Naboo. Gunray's vindictiveness towards Senator Amidala led him to pledge the Trade Federation's support to Count Dooku's emerging Confederacy of Independent Systems. Thinking about Gunray and all he had done to her made Amidala briefly understand what Anakin Skywalker must have felt as he [[Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars|cut down]] an entire [[Unidentified Tusken village|Tusken Raider camp]]. As an opportunistic bully, Gunray used the Trade Federation's wealth to manipulate the Rodian Senator Onaconda Farr into luring Senator Amidala into a trap in return for sending much-needed aid to the planet Rodia. However, Farr and Amidala took advantage of Gunray's vindictiveness and opportunism to capture the Viceroy. Gunray regularly avoided justice for his crimes. Dealing with Gunray was not pleasant for Sidious, who was happy to delegate matters involving the Neimoidian to Dooku. Gunray often used the pervading view of Neimoidian cowardice to his advantage, stating he was merely an "innocent pawn" when captured, causing his enemies to underestimate how dangerous he could truly be. While Gunray preferred to leave most of the fighting to his battle droids, he was still capable of physical action when push came to shove. During an escape hatched by the traitorous Senate [[Commando]] Argyus, Gunray assisted his rescuer by knocking out the Clone Commander Gree. Nute Gunray often clashed with General Grievous, believing that Count Dooku gave the [[Cyborg|cybernetically]] enhanced general preferential treatment. Grievous, for his part, detested the self-serving Neimoidian Viceroy.{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic and Separatist Ships (1)}} Almost immediately he offended Grievous, whom he dismissed as a mere droid.{{EncyclopediaCite|The Separatists}} Shortly after the Clone Wars began, Grievous lost his flagship, the ''[[Malevolence]]'', at the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula|Battle]] of the [[Kaliida Nebula]].{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}} This setback was a source of satisfaction for Nute Gunray. Gunray was a Neimoidian [[Gender|male]] who was 1.91 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|feet]], 3 inches) tall. He weighed 90 [[kilogram]]s, had [[Color|red]]-gold [[eye]]s and green skin. ==Skills and abilities== As the leader of the Trade Federation, Nute Gunray was skilled in negotiations. He was also known for escaping justice and managing to retain his titles and wealth. ==Equipment== Nute Gunray wore Neimoidian [[clothing]], including the [[Viceroy's collar]] and his crested fabric tiara.''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' Gunray also wore an ornate headdress, was a sign of the Neimoidian's wealth. At the time of his death, he was wearing a red [[Viceroy gown]].''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' ==Behind the scenes== ===Development=== [[File:GunrayConceptArt.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Early concept art by [[Iain McCaig]]]] Nute Gunray was played by [[Silas Carson]] in all of the [[prequel trilogy]] films. For ''The Phantom Menace'' Nute Gunray's mask was sculpted by Gary Pollard.{{YouTube|video=6fevC0IluiY|text=Gary Pollard - Creature Sculptor SW Ep 1 - FORCEMANIA (2023)|channel=Forcemania|name=Forcemania|date=2025-12-09}} Carson also acted as Lott Dod, Jedi Master [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]], and [[Antidar Williams]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']]. In [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]], Gunray was voiced by [[Tom Kenny]]. ===Contradictions=== {{Quote|Have you ever encountered a Jedi Knight before, sir?''"
"''Well, no, but I don't— seal off the bridge!|Rune Haako and Nute Gunray, in ''The Phantom Menace''|}} When the [[2019]] roleplaying sourcebook ''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' described Gunray's rise to power over the Trade Federation through the Eriadu Conference, it stated that Gunray had been able "to ascend to power as the Trade Federation's viceroy." The [[2021]] reference book "[[The Crisis on Naboo]]" would go onto claim that Gunray only was named viceroy in the first place thanks to the Eriadu Conference.{{EncyclopediaCite|The Crisis on Naboo}} Meanwhile, in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] version of events, [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Gunray]] secured the [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|viceroy title]] first and then cemented his control after the [[Eriadu Trade Summit|Eriadu Conference]].[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] In fact, the canon comic [[Jedi Knights 5|''Jedi Knights'' 5]][[Jedi Knights 5|''Jedi Knights'' 5]]—which was released on [[July 2]], [[2025]], written by [[Marc Guggenheim]], and illustrated by [[Madibek Musabekov]]{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/122256/star_wars_jedi_knights_2025_5|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knights (2025) #5}}—went onto feature Gunray with the title of Viceroy by 34 BBY, thereby placing its events before the Eriadu Conference, which occurred in 33 BBY. Therefore in canon, Gunray must have already held the title of Viceroy before securing total control of the Federation, much as he did in Legends. With this in mind, the sentence in ''Rise of the Separatists'' means that Gunray must have arisen to power through his title of Viceroy, instead of receiving it as part of his rise. ''Jedi Knights'' 5, which is set years before ''The Phantom Menace'', also sees Gunray deal with Jedi Master Yaddle and Jedi Knight Seera Longa during his conference on Liskan. However, in ''The Phantom Menace'', a nervous Gunray informs Rune Haako that he has never encountered Jedi Knights before Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi revealed themselves aboard the ''Saak'ak''. This article assumes Gunray's line in ''The Phantom Menace'' means the Viceroy had never previously been involved in a combat encounter with the Jedi. Indeed, ''Star Wars'' Legends works had depicted Gunray interacting with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] before the events of ''The Phantom Menace''.[[Star Wars (1998) 37|''Star Wars'' (1998)
